FN-KKX85UU-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 264
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Security Sponsor: Representative Danny Crawford
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/20/2025
House Bill 264 as introduced would combine: (1) the existing vessel registration fees that are
based on length; and (2) the existing additional $5 registration fee deposited into the State
Reservoir Management Grant Fund into a single fee. This bill would not otherwise affect state
or local funding.
Page 1

FN-KKX85UU-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 264
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Danny Crawford
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/01/2025
House Bill 264 as passed the House of Representatives would increase receipts to the State
Water Safety Fund by an estimated $794,000 from the additional $15 fee assessed for failure to
properly register or renew registration for a vessel on time. This bill would also combine: (1) the
existing vessel registration fees that are based on length; and (2) the existing additional $5
registration fee deposited into the State Reservoir Management Grant Fund into a single fee.
